title: Bouncing Moon
what: Speech that comes back with the start and end time of every character, so the page always knows which word is being spoken.

inputs.label: Story
inputs.value: Once, on a very quiet night, the moon got tired of climbing. So it sat down on the roof of the radio station, right next to the antenna, and listened. It heard the kettle humming. It heard a cat purring on the windowsill. It heard the night host whisper, goodnight, little island. And the moon, which had never stayed anywhere for long, decided that this roof was the coziest place in the whole sky. So if your night feels a little brighter, now you know why.

snippet:
d = requests.post(f"https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice}/with-timestamps",
    headers={"xi-api-key": KEY},
    json={"text": STORY, "model_id": "eleven_v4"}).json()
audio = base64.b64decode(d["audio_base64"])
times = d["alignment"]["character_start_times_seconds"]
